sources.entry: 23. CustomPod - Improve productivity by getting a personalized daily audio briefing on updates from your favorite sites/apps.

summary.name: CustomPod
summary.one_liner: CustomPod builds a personalized daily audio podcast from blogs, web searches, social media, and personal content on topics you choose.
use_cases: Get a morning audio briefing on overnight news
Listen to industry updates during a commute
Follow multiple Reddit pages in one audio feed
Summarize long-form articles into quick listens
summary.what_it_does: CustomPod generates a daily podcast from sources the user selects, including blogs, web searches, social media, and personal content. It offers custom feeds covering topics such as news, weather, and tech. It provides AI summaries of long-form content to help users grasp key points quickly. It also includes smart filtering to prioritize relevant content and quick updates on breaking news in chosen fields.
notable: Builds an audio podcast from blogs, web searches, social media and personal content
Can group multiple Reddit pages into one feed
Listed in eudk/awesome-ai-tools under Voice-Related AI Tools
caveats: Automatic generation and other features require the paid Pro plan; the free plan is limited
Pricing details beyond the free tier are not shown on the page
